EmailTemplate.subject: Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Updates in Sales CRM
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Updates in Sales CRM
Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Updates in Sales CRM
Hello [NAME] ,
Our records show that several of your opportunities have exceeded the SLA for their current pipeline stage and require updates in Sales CRM.
To help you stay current and maintain pipeline accuracy, we've compiled a list of opportunities that may need attention below. Please review each one and update the required fields to ensure they can progress through the pipeline.
Opportunities Requiring Action: [REQUIRED_FIELDS]
You can view all opportunities currently breaching SLAs in the following report: Opportunity Report
This weekly summary is intended as a gentle reminder to help maintain data quality and pipeline visibility.
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
Sales Excellence Team
